case_name: Henderson v. Meridian Insurance Group, Inc. et al.
description: Ground truth for the document_checklist template applied to the Henderson v. Meridian sample.  Evaluates which documents a personal-injury/bad-faith litigation file should contain, what is present in source_docs/, and what is still missing.

present_documents.notes: Civil complaint filed 2025-04-28; covers all four counts
CCSO Incident No. CCSO-2025-0315-4471; Webb citation and narrative
Certified records — Rush ER + Shirley Ryan AbilityLab; billing $87,534.62
Meridian denial letter dated 2025-04-14; three stated denial grounds
Signed statement of Maria C. Chen; eyewitness to distracted driving
Preliminary title commitment on Henderson's condo — reveals AbilityLab lien

missing_documents.description: Expert medical witness affidavit or life-care plan (future damages)
missing_documents.notes: Required to substantiate $200,000 future medical cost estimate in complaint

missing_documents.description: Wage loss documentation from Harmon & Peck Engineering Associates
missing_documents.notes: Complaint alleges $180,000 in lost wages; no employer letter or pay stubs

missing_documents.description: Accident reconstruction report or vehicle inspection report (both vehicles)
missing_documents.notes: Complaint references 38-foot push and 45-mph impact estimate; no expert report

missing_documents.description: Swift Logistics driver qualification file for Marcus Webb (FMCSA § 391.51)
missing_documents.notes: Negligent entrustment count (Count III) requires proof of known driving history

missing_documents.description: Plaintiff's March 20, 2025 demand letter to Meridian
missing_documents.notes: Referenced in complaint ¶ 12 and denial letter; not included in file

missing_documents.description: Deposition transcripts, interrogatory responses, document productions
missing_documents.notes: Case is pre-discovery at filing date; expected to be produced in due course

missing_documents.description: Webb's navigation tablet data and Swift Logistics telematics/EDR download
